title: Fix three bugs in Rust math utilities: clamp, factorial, and Collatz steps
description: Dirty-cleanup Rust task: three functions have subtle logic bugs. All tests are written correctly; the implementations must be fixed to make them pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs. All 9 tests must pass after your fixes.

Bug 1 — clamp:
  Current: n.min(lo).max(hi)
  Fix: n.max(lo).min(hi)

Bug 2 — factorial base case:
  Current: if n <= 1 { 0 } else { n * factorial(n - 1) }
  Fix: base case must return 1, not 0

Bug 3 — collatz_steps odd branch:
  Current: 3 * n - 1
  Fix: 3 * n + 1  (the correct Collatz rule)

Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
